arrival_steps: Enter Zachry at the mapped level-1 entrance.
Use the signed elevators to reach Level 5.
Follow the main shared corridor to the learning-studio wing (rooms 582-598).
Continue to room 596, beside 598 at the end of the learning-studio wing.
departure_steps: From 596, follow the shared corridor back from the learning-studio wing to the elevators.
Take an elevator to Level 1, then leave through the mapped level-1 entrance.
indoor.guidance_note: Indoor directions follow the published plan; room access and elevator service are unconfirmed. Walking estimates cover the outdoor route to the entrance.

sources.detail: PDF pages 7 and 11: level-1 entrances/elevators and level-5 learning studios including 596. Schematic guidance, not indoor positioning.
Current published building hours; holiday, event and room-specific closures can differ.
